test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The manager insisted that (1)/ every member completes (2)/ the survey before (3)/ the deadline expired. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is in **part 2** of the sentence due to the incorrect verb form "**completes**."
 
• The verb "**insisted**" is a verb of requirement or demand. When such verbs (e.g., insist, suggest, demand, mandate) are followed by "**that**," they trigger the **Subjunctive Mood**.
 
• In the subjunctive mood, the **base form** of the verb (the infinitive without "to") is used for all subjects, regardless of whether the subject is singular or plural.
 
• Therefore, "completes" should be replaced with "**complete**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager insisted that **every member complete** the survey before the deadline expired."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "The manager insisted that"** – This part is correct; it establishes the demand that triggers the change in the following clause.
 
• **3: "the survey before"** – This part is grammatically correct as it provides the object and the preposition for the time condition.
 
• **4: "the deadline expired."** – This part is correct. In a past-tense narrative (insisted), the use of "expired" maintains the sequence of events in the past.
 
• **Subjunctive Rule:** Even though "every member" is singular, the subjunctive mood ignores the standard "-s" ending used in the present indicative tense.
